subject: SOC 2 intake: log retention, evidence owners, and kickoff plan
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@apexbio.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@apexbio.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 intake: scheduling and brief context

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this on. Were starting a SOC 2 review at ApexBio and would like to do an intake call to go over scope, log retention windows, and evidence handoff. Our security team would like a 45-60 minute call to cover: environment diagram, access controls, audit log availability, and encryption at rest/in transit.

Are you available next week? Our initial windows:
- Tue 15 Jun, 10:00-11:30 PT
- Wed 16 Jun, 13:00-16:00 PT
- Thu 17 Jun, 09:00-12:00 PT

I attached a short spreadsheet with our preliminary questions ("ApexBio_SOC2_Prelim_Questions.xlsx"). Please loop in whoever will own logs and sample exports.

Best,
Elena Morales
Security Program Lead
ApexBio

Attachment: ApexBio_SOC2_Prelim_Questions.xlsx (spreadsheet, 14KB)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@apexbio.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 intake: scheduling and brief context

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the questions. We can run a 60-minute intake to make sure we capture owners and confirm evidence windows. My availability:
- Tue 15 Jun, 10:30-11:30 PT (works for me)
- Wed 16 Jun, 14:00-15:00 PT (alt)

Kimberly, Im looping you in to own logs/sample exports. Marissa, would you take deployment diagrams and CAIQ pre-read?

Pre-call ask for ApexBio team (to speed the intake):
- A list of specific endpoints/services in scope (hosts, model endpoints)
- Any retention floors you must prove (e.g., 90 days logs)
- A sample of the kind of log youd like exported (syslog/JSON)

Ive attached a simple kickoff agenda and a short manifest we can use to track artifacts. If those times dont work I can ask the team to open other slots.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Manager, Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: kickoff-agenda.md (text)
Attachment: redwood-logging-sample-manifest.csv (csv)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: ApexBio intake owners and pre-reads

Quick internal sync — assigning owners so were clear before the call: 
- Kimberly Park: audit logs & retention exports (will prepare a 7-sample export covering the last 90 days)
- Marissa Cole: network/infra diagrams, CAIQ mapping and control owners
- David Kim: demo of log export process and sample S3 transfer

Action items for us before Tue 15 Jun 10:30 PT:
1) Kimberly: drop sample exports + README to the Drive folder (link below) by EOD Mon 14 Jun.
2) Marissa: attach deployment diagram and a one-pager mapping CAIQ sections to our artifacts.
3) David: prepare a 10-min walkthrough of the export flow (well keep the main call to 60 minutes).

Link to pre-read folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cApexBioIntake

Ill also prepare the short slide deck with the agenda so the Apex team has a clear list of who owns what.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Security Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@apexbio.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@apexbio.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 intake: log retention, evidence owners, and kickoff plan

Thanks Jonas and Kimberly — Tue 15 Jun 10:30 PT works. Ive sent a calendar invite to the attendees and uploaded the preliminary question bank to our shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ApexBio-SOC2-questions. Rajiv (cc) will join from our engineering team and will bring the list of services in scope.

We also attached a short spreadsheet with a couple of clarifying asks: which log fields are already indexed vs. what youd prefer to export (timestamp, user_id, request_id, action). Ill leave that with you to confirm ahead of the call.

Calendar invite: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:30-11:30 PT
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ApexBio-SOC2-questions
Attachment: ApexBio_SOC2_Prelim_Questions.xlsx (updated)

Best,
Elena

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@apexbio.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 intake: log retention, evidence owners, and kickoff plan

Confirmed — thanks for the invite. Final checklist before the call (items well close during the 60-minute intake):
- ApexBio to confirm exact hosts/endpoints in scope (Rajiv)
- Redwood to provide 7 sample log exports + README (Kimberly)
- Redwood to provide deployment diagram and CAIQ mapping (Marissa)
- Redwood to demonstrate export flow and transfer steps (David)
- Agree on retention floors and any filtering required for PII removal

Ill kick things off with a short SLO/latency/retention framing so we can align expectations, then hand off to Kimberly/Marissa for artifact walkthroughs. After the call Ill share an action log and next steps (DocuSign/secure transfer instructions if Apex wants us to sign an NDA or transfer agreement).

Forwarded for context: 
On Sat, Jun 12, 2027 at 09:14 AM Elena Morales <elena.morales@apexbio.com> wrote:
> Thanks for taking this on. Were starting a SOC 2 review at ApexBio and would like to do an intake call to go over scope, log retention windows, and evidence handoff....

See you on Tue.

- Jonas

Redwood Inference
